kit.name: UXor
kit.description: Flowbite v4 and Tailwind CSS v4 components, layouts, blocks and a form theme for Symfony UX, with all behavior in Stimulus controllers so they keep working under Turbo and Live Components.

alert.summary: A message for information, success, a warning or an error, optionally dismissible.

autocomplete.summary: Searchable selects with Symfony UX Autocomplete (Tom Select), styled with the theme: one choice, several, values typed by the user, options searched on the server. Works through the form theme ('autocomplete' => true) and as an Autocomplete component outside forms.

avatar.summary: A user's picture, with a fallback, in several sizes, round or with rounded corners.

badge.summary: A small label or count next to other content, such as a number of comments.

breadcrumb.summary: A trail of links showing where the current page sits in the site hierarchy.

button.summary: A button, or a link that looks like one, in several colors, sizes and styles.

button-group.summary: Several buttons or links joined into one control.

calendar.summary: Pick a date, several dates or a range inline: keyboard navigation, disabled dates and bounds, several months, locales, right to left, hidden inputs for forms and a model prop for Live Components.

card.summary: A box grouping related content: text, images, a form.

chart.summary: Charts with Symfony UX Chart.js in the theme's colors, light and dark, each with its data as a table; from arrays or ChartBuilderInterface, updated in place by Live Components.

checkbox.summary: A square box to select one or more options.

connected-accounts.summary: Connected provider identities with distinct CSRF-protected POST connection and disconnection forms, and explanations for unavailable actions.

manifest.name: ConnectedAccounts
manifest.description: An account settings card with CSRF-protected connection forms and explicit unavailable-action feedback.

dashboard-home.summary: A dashboard home: page header, key figures, two cards and a table of recent orders.

manifest.name: DashboardHome
manifest.description: A dashboard home: page header, key figures, two cards and a table of recent orders.

data-table.summary: A server-driven table: search, filters, sortable columns, page size and pages in a Turbo Frame, with Back and Forward through each state. Copies PHP classes into src/UXor/.

data-table-live.summary: data-table as a Live Component: search while typing, filters, sorting, pages and row selection for bulk actions, its state in the URL. Copies PHP classes into src/UXor/.

date-picker.summary: A date or a range picked in a calendar that opens from a button or a typed field; a DateType opts in through the form theme.

drawer.summary: A panel sliding over one side of the page, for navigation, filters or details, as a native <dialog>.

dropdown.summary: A menu that opens from a button and closes when the user clicks or focuses outside it.

dropzone.summary: File uploads with Symfony UX Dropzone, styled with the theme: drag and drop or browse, a preview of the picked image, several files that add up across picks, keyboard focus kept after a pick or a removal; a DropzoneType renders as one through the form theme.

editor.summary: A rich text editor (Tiptap) that stores restricted HTML: paragraphs, bold, italic, strike, code, headings, lists, quotes, links; a keyboard-friendly toolbar, a link dialog, a counter. EditorType sanitizes every submit (symfony/html-sanitizer), and flowbite_editor_html prints stored HTML.

empty-state.summary: What a list or page shows when it has nothing yet, with a way forward.

floating.summary: The positioning shared by dropdown, popover (so date-picker) and tooltip, one JavaScript module: a floating element placed next to the element it belongs to, flipped to the other side when it does not fit, kept in the viewport and following it on scroll and resize.

forgot-password.summary: A card asking for an email address to send a password reset link, then confirming it was sent.

manifest.name: ForgotPasswordForm
manifest.description: A card asking for an email address to send a password reset link, then confirming it was sent.

form-field.summary: A labelled form control with its help text and error message, wired by id (used by the form theme).

form-theme.summary: A Symfony form theme that renders every row through FormField and every control through the kit's Input, Select, Textarea, Checkbox, Radio, Label and Button components.

indicator.summary: A dot or number placed on another element: a status, a count, a loading label.

input.summary: A single-line field for any input type: text, email, number, password, URL…

kbd.summary: A keyboard key or shortcut shown in text.

label.summary: A text element that identifies form controls and other content.

layouts.summary: Page layouts to extend: an app shell with sidebar, navbar with its menu, and mobile nav, a centered column for login, signup and password reset, settings, errors and a blank page.

login.summary: A sign-in card rendering a Symfony login form through the form theme, with the last authentication error.

manifest.name: LoginForm
manifest.description: A sign-in card rendering a Symfony login form through the form theme, with the last authentication error.

markdown-editor.summary: A Markdown field: a native textarea with a small toolbar, and a Preview tab rendered on the server (a Live Component) exactly as the stored Markdown will print; raw HTML, images and unsafe links never reach the page. MarkdownType limits the source, and flowbite_markdown_html prints it.

mobile-nav.summary: The app's navigation on small screens: a menu button in the navbar opening a modal drawer that holds the side nav, closed by a link, Escape, the backdrop and every Turbo visit.

modal.summary: A dialog over the page, as a native <dialog>, with a close button.

nav-menu.summary: The navbar's menu: links and buttons opening submenus of links, nested at any depth, as a disclosure navigation; the current page and its submenus are marked, and the same menu opens in place in a mobile nav's drawer.

navbar.summary: The bar on top of the app: brand, navigation menu, search, actions, and the menu button opening the sidebar or a mobile nav on small screens.

navigation.summary: What the navigation recipes (nav-menu, sidebar, side-nav, section-nav, mobile-nav) share, one JavaScript module: the current page's link marked aria-current="page", whether a click on a link navigates this tab, a navigation opened over the page closed once the screen grows.

not-found.summary: The content of a 404 (or any error) page: status, title, explanation and a way back.

manifest.name: NotFound
manifest.description: The content of a 404 (or any error) page: status, title, explanation and a way back.

oauth.summary: Symfony OAuth2/OIDC authentication, provider adapters, expiring attempts and explicit account connections, with an authentication layout.

manifest.name: OAuth
manifest.description: Server-side OAuth2 and OpenID Connect sign-in, with expiring attempts, Symfony Security and account connections.

oauth-provider-button.summary: A Google, Facebook, GitHub or custom provider sign-in link with an enforced full browser handoff and no Turbo prefetch; Google uses its official local light and dark artwork.

manifest.name: OAuthProviderButton
manifest.description: A provider sign-in link that starts the application's OAuth flow with a full browser navigation.

page-header.summary: The top of a page: its title, a short description and the page's actions.

pagination.summary: Links to the pages of a long list.

popover.summary: Free content anchored to a button (text, links, a small form) in a non-modal dialog that closes on Escape, a click outside or when the focus leaves it.

progress.summary: A bar showing how far a task has come.

radio.summary: A round button to choose one option among several.

section-nav.summary: Vertical tabs that navigate: one link per page of a group of pages (settings), the current one marked, a column on large screens and a strip that scrolls sideways on small ones.

select.summary: A list to choose one or more options.

settings-profile.summary: A profile settings card: avatar, name and a Symfony form rendered through the form theme.

manifest.name: SettingsProfile
manifest.description: A profile settings card: avatar, name and a Symfony form rendered through the form theme.

side-nav.summary: A multi-level navigation tree: links in branches that open and close, at any depth, with the keyboard of an ARIA tree view; the open branches hold across Turbo visits, and the branch of the current page opens.

sidebar.summary: The app's main navigation: grouped links with icons and counts, collapsible to icons, opened over the page on small screens.

signup.summary: A registration card rendering a Symfony form through the form theme.

manifest.name: SignupForm
manifest.description: A registration card rendering a Symfony form through the form theme.

skeleton.summary: Placeholders shaped like the content that is loading.

social-login.summary: Provider login or registration choices, safe feedback and an optional password-form slot in one authentication card.

manifest.name: SocialLogin
manifest.description: A provider login or registration card with feedback and optional password-form content.

spinner.summary: A spinning indicator for a loading state.

stat-card.summary: A key figure with its label and, optionally, how it changed over a period.

tabs.summary: Tabs that switch between panels in place, in a row or a column, with the arrow keys of the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern.

textarea.summary: A multi-line text field, for a comment or a description.

theme.summary: Flowbite's color roles, with this kit's contrast fixes and its roles for text on a solid fill (fg-on-*), as one stylesheet to import in assets/styles/app.css. A role is a named color with a light and a dark value, used as a utility: bg-brand, text-heading, border-default.

theme-toggle.summary: A button switching between the light and dark themes, remembered in localStorage and following the system preference until the user chooses.

toast.summary: Short-lived notifications in a fixed region, added on page load or by Turbo Streams, dismissed after a timeout or by the user.

toggle.summary: A switch for an on/off setting.

tooltip.summary: A short text shown while a control is hovered or focused, also announced as its description.

turbo.summary: What the recipes ask about Turbo's copies of a page, one JavaScript module: whether a turbo:before-cache leaves the page on screen (a frame visit promoted to history) or an element is moved into the next page (data-turbo-permanent), and whether a controller connects in a cached copy.
